title: Suggestion result
description: What the agent answers with: candidates, or the typed verdict that no workspace could be composed. The agent states each line's name and amount as its catalogue tools returned them, and the application sums the lines for each candidate's total; no band label is carried, because the application orders the candidates by the order the agent returned them. It carries NO USAGE: a model cannot observe a call count or a token count, so the run's cost follows the answer as a separate object - see run-usage.schema.json.

status.description: notWorkspace and catalogueUnavailable are results, not errors: the application words them and reports no failure. catalogueUnavailable means this customer was offered no catalogue tool, or one reported a failure, so nothing was composed from memory.

reason.description: A one-line reason, present when the status is not suggested.

options.description: Up to three genuinely different setups. Fewer is fewer - never padded with a near-duplicate to reach three. Empty when the verdict is notWorkspace.

lines.description: Which SKU goes in which slot, and how many. A slot the request said nothing about is left out.

rationale.description: The model's own words, purpose only. The application caps it and strips URLs, markup and currency amounts before a customer sees it.

slot.description: The slot this line fills. Kept in step with the request schema by a test, so every file stays self-contained and any consumer can validate one without a registry.

sku.description: The SKU as a catalogue search returned it. The customer is shown the name beside it, never the SKU alone.

name.description: The product's name, exactly as the catalogue tool returned it. Nothing the model invents reaches the customer.

quantity.description: How many of this SKU. The slot's capacity was stated in the request and is the model's to respect.

amount.description: This line's total for its quantity, taken from the price the catalogue tool returned. The application sums the lines for the candidate's total rather than asking the model to add.

why.description: The model's own words for this line, purpose only. Capped and stripped like the rationale.
